messages:
deploy-bot: Starting scheduled config-only rollout for service `inference-router` (routing limiter + soft throttle). Rollout plan: 0% -> 50% over 30m with telemetry gating. Change window tonight 2026-03-20 22:00 UTC. Commit: a3f9c2b. Release doc: https://redwood.internal/rel/2760012345
lena-g: ACK. I'll watch latency + queue depth dashboards. Setting gating metric: p95 latency and queue depth increase.
chris-k: quick note — this touches route-balancer token limit. We should pin routing-config version to `rc-2026-03-20` in the rollout so downstream schedulers see deterministic limits.
priya-oncall: heads-up: we're already investigating a degredation for customer X on dedicated infra, want to delay 15m? current incident: INC-2026-0421
jamie-p: If we delay, keep the rollout window but adjust start to +15m. gating rules: abort if p95 > 350ms or error_rate>0.5% for 5m, or queue_depth > baseline*1.8.
lena-g: I added the auto-rollback policy to the deploy config. snippet:
```
rollout:
  ramp: 0->50% over 30m
  gates:
    - metric: p95_latency_ms
      abort_if: ">350 for 5m"
    - metric: router_error_rate
      abort_if: ">0.5% for 5m"
    - metric: router_queue_depth
      abort_if: ">1.8x baseline for 3m"
  version_pin: rc-2026-03-20
```
ops-bot: Noted. Scheduled deploy start: 2026-03-20T22:15:00Z (adjusted). I'll post progress updates.
maria-r: FYI - Instrumentation query to watch during ramp:
```
select time, p50_latency, p95_latency, errors_per_min, queue_depth
from inference_router.metrics
where env='prod' and shard in ('us-east-1')
order by time desc limit 20
```
priya-oncall: thanks. I'll hold on the incident, but if we see >2x queue depth we should pause. I'll be live for the window.
ops-bot: Deploy started: step 0 -> 5% at 2026-03-20T22:15:00Z. Progress: apply config to 12 hosts.
ops-bot: Progress update: ramp to 10% complete (target 5m). Applying to next batch.
ops-bot: Alert: small spike in `router_queue_depth` in us-east-1 at 22:18Z (+1.6x). p95 still within threshold.
sre-oncall: Seeing queue_depth trend up on 22:18-22:21, p95 unchanged but queuing increasing. Pausing ramp at 10% to investigate.
chris-k: Good call. Any errors in logs? paste a couple lines:
```
WARN router: route-limiter triggered for shard-3, backlog=84
INFO kernel: batching-window reduced due to limiter
```
lena-g: Looks like limiter triggered earlier than expected for some small shard cluster. Options: reduce limiter severity, increase warmup window, or rollback. Given customer incident and trend I vote rollback.
jamie-p: Agree with rollback. We can't risk customer impact for a config change we can iterate on.
ops-bot: Executing rollback to previous config `rc-2026-03-19` now... Command: `/deploy rollback inference-router --to rc-2026-03-19 --reason "queue-depth spike during staged throttle rollout"`
ops-bot: Rollback complete at 2026-03-20T22:24:50Z. All hosts reverted. Verification: router_queue_depth returning to baseline.
deploy-bot: Rollback logged: a3f9c2b -> rc-2026-03-19, notes: paused at 10% then rolled back due to queue-depth gating.
priya-oncall: Confirming customer X metrics improving. No further impact observed.
maria-r: Filing a short incident postmortem entry and adding a checklist item to run a small synthetic load test in stage that mimics dedicated shards before next rollout.
lena-g: For the follow-up deploy we'll: 1) add a 15m warmup at 2% traffic, 2) decrease limiter sensitivity, 3) run traffic replay against staging shard clusters. I'll open a PR with the adjusted config.
chris-k: Also adding a change-note to release notes: "Config attempt 2760012345 rolled back — further tuning planned". We'll schedule a quieter window and coordinate with customer success.
jamie-p: Closing loop: update release tracker and re-schedule for next maintenance slot. :thumbsup:
